_about: Isooctane (1) + MTBE (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 95.96 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of isooctane, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Reddy, K. V. N. S., Prasad, D.H.L., Krishnaiah, A.[Abburi], Phase equilibria for binary systems of octane boosters with 2,2,4-trimethylpentane, Fluid Phase Equilib. 230 (2005) 105-108
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 9. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.13 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
